scope: Partial formalization of the basin-density paper. Checks the complete abstract Banach-valued two-scale averaging lemma with its rate, irrationality of the specified scale ratio, the counting-recurrence bootstrap and its power-law specialization, actual shortcut affine and endpoint-count bounds, admissible parity-word encoding and injectivity, the finite endpoint head sum, the unconditional infinite geometric-word tail, and raw-to-shortcut reachability and 3-divisible target bridges. The cylinder bound is checked under an explicit head-plus-tail expansion equality; that equality for the stationary measure remains unformalized. Arithmetic first-passage estimates, basin-density existence, weighted Green limits, canonical-limit identification, and the external Mazur theorem interfaces are not certified by this report. No Collatz conjecture proof is claimed.
